reviews.text: This is the best vet in town, Dr Metivet cares about the animals and their owners. All the team is involved and dedicated to the animals. I am such grateful as Dr Metivet saved my dog  a few months ago and he is present anytime for my dog's health. I can't consider to go anywhere else. Thanks to the team to be so kind and so professional.

This veterinary clinic is by far the best I know. The veterinarian and their team are competent, gentle, and compassionate, always offering sound advice without being pushy. Dr. Metivet and Salomé have been taking care of my cats for a long time, and I wouldn't change clinics for anything. I recommend them without hesitation.
An excellent veterinarian, always available in case of a problem even when he is busy, always ready to help, in short, an excellent practitioner whom I recommend without reservation.

A deplorable experience. A dangerous environment and a completely unprofessional handling of customer complaints.

I arrived at this veterinary clinic with my two cats, in a pet stroller, and my 7-year-old daughter. I had barely stepped through the door when an off-leash dog rushed towards the stroller, trying to get at my cats.

Instinctively, I extended my foot to create a barrier between the dog and my cats to protect them. Instead of taking responsibility and controlling her dog, its owner started yelling at me and repeatedly calling me stupid, in front of my little girl, simply because she didn't appreciate me using my foot to protect my animals.

What made this situation even more unacceptable was the reaction of the clinic staff. The receptionist let this woman verbally abuse me without intervening, and then even tried to justify her behavior by pointing out that she had seen me extend my foot. At no point did she acknowledge that the dog should have been kept under control, nor that I had every right to protect my animals.

When I tried to discuss this incident with the receptionist and the veterinarian, I was met with complete indifference. I was told they were too busy or too stressed to deal with it. The veterinarian even stated that he preferred a peaceful life, as if simply having to address a legitimate concern about animal safety was an excessive inconvenience.

I, too, prefer a peaceful life, especially when taking my animals to the vet.

A veterinary clinic should be a safe and controlled environment for all animals, including cats. Allowing dogs to freely approach other animals, without supervision or control, creates unnecessary risks and puts their owners in impossible situations.

The incident itself was shocking, but the staff's dismissive attitude and refusal to acknowledge the problem were even more disappointing.

If you are considering taking your cats or other small animals to this clinic, be aware that you may find yourself in an environment where animals are not properly controlled, and you won't be able to rely on staff support should a problem arise.

Everyone here was so kind and helpful! I needed some fairly complicated paperwork completed to bring my two dogs into Great Britain, and they went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed. They worked with the appropriate authorities, helped me sort through all the requirements, and made a stressful process so much easier. Very patient, professional, and genuinely lovely. So grateful for their help!
A veterinarian who listens very carefully to both the animal and its owner, offers excellent advice, and whose colleagues are always top-notch!

I don’t write reviews often, but this clinic earned it. My dog Forrest means the world to me, and I don’t trust his care to just anyone.

The doctor here is, without exaggeration, the best vet we’ve ever worked with. Thorough, genuinely attentive, never rushed. Every finding was explained clearly, and I was walked through the options instead of being pushed toward one answer. Forrest was treated like he was their own dog.

The nurses were just as impressive calm, gentle, and clearly skilled at reading dogs. Forrest usually gets tense at the vet, but here he was relaxed and wagging on the way OUT. That never happens.

Easy scheduling, fast follow-up, and a level of care and professionalism you rarely find. If you want a team that treats your dog like family and communicates with you honestly, this is the place. We’d drive out of our way to keep coming back.

An exceptional veterinarian, clearly the best we've ever had.
Remarkably kind and precise in his work, he treated our two cats in the best possible way.
We certainly won't call on anyone else when it comes to our pets' care.
Thank you again!

The best vet we've ever had. Go without hesitation.

The assistant is also lovely and fantastic! A true love for animals, which is reassuring and a pleasure to see.
Absolute best vet in Paris

The best veterinarian I've ever had the pleasure of meeting.

I have two 8-year-old Spitz dogs, and over the years I've seen many veterinarians. But this doctor was recommended to me as the best for spaying my dogs, and now I understand why.

My little Lilou weighs only 1.3 kg and has suffered from epilepsy since she was a puppy. Having her spayed was a huge risk, and I was very scared. However, I decided to trust this doctor with my two girls.

Today, Lilou has already had her stitches removed and is doing wonderfully. Baggy is also recovering very well from his surgery.

I want to tell anyone who is hesitating: don't hesitate. This doctor knows exactly what he's doing, deeply loves animals, and cares for them with tremendous professionalism and compassion.

I will always be grateful to him and his entire team. Thank you so much for your work, your kindness and your dedication.

Dr. Pierre Metivet has been Archibald’s veterinarian since I first got him at 2 months old, and now Archie is already 10 months old. Throughout all our visits, Dr. Metivet has consistently been kind, honest, genuine, and incredibly skilled in assessing Archie’s health and overall well-being.

As an American living in Paris, I especially appreciate that he speaks fluent English, which makes it so much easier for me to fully understand Archie’s health, treatments, and care. The entire staff is also always warm, welcoming, and kind, and every visit to the clinic has been a truly pleasant experience.

I’m writing this review not only because I deeply admire Dr. Metivet’s knowledge and professionalism, but also because it is rare nowadays to find a veterinarian who genuinely cares about animals with such empathy and compassion, rather than treating the profession as purely transactional.

If you are looking for a veterinarian in Paris, look no further. Dr. Metivet is truly one of the best vets you could ever hope to find for your pet.

Dr. Métivet has been treating our dog Luna for several years. We can never thank him and his assistant Salomé enough for their exceptional care.

What sets them apart, beyond their expertise, is their profoundly humane and intelligent approach to veterinary medicine. It's thoughtful medicine, never excessive, with decisions always tailored to the animal's actual condition and made primarily in its best interest.

Dr. Métivet has always been able to observe Luna holistically—with discernment, perspective, and common sense. He prioritizes quality of life, avoids unnecessary stress, while knowing when to intervene pragmatically and effectively as needed. This ability has become rare and deserves to be highlighted.

Their availability has been unfailing: always present, always reachable, always attentive—even during the most difficult times. We have always felt supported by genuinely dedicated people who love animals and practice their profession with conscience and compassion.

A huge thank you to Salomé for her gentleness, kindness, and support over the years.

And when the time came, Luna passed away peacefully, surrounded by those who loved her, in this clinic she knew so well—a clinic where she knew how to scare the team, make them laugh, and be admired for her tenacity and incredible will to live.

"The eternal Luna" (Salomé): We know that Luna will leave a lasting mark on the soul of this practice, just as she will leave a profound mark on our lives.

Thank you for everything!
Finally, a veterinarian worthy of the name! He's fabulous, loves animals, and isn't in it just for the money, unlike so many others. You can take your little darlings there with complete confidence.

I want to express my complete satisfaction with the care provided to our three dogs, Alma, Lilou, and Osky. Our veterinarian demonstrates great professionalism, is always responsive, and is particularly attentive to both the animals and their owners.

Each visit takes place in a trusting atmosphere, with clear explanations and tailored advice. We sense a genuine concern for the animals' well-being, which is very reassuring.

We are deeply grateful for the quality of care and the availability he demonstrates daily. I highly recommend his services. Thank you also to the assistants, who are very professional, competent, and pleasant.

A true vet with experience.
Very friendly and clear.
Thank you.
A caring vet who had all the info we needed about travelling from Paris to London with our cat. Highly recommend.

An exceptional veterinarian, very rigorous and passionate about his work, he is patient and deeply committed to animal health, not to mention his great kindness.
Thank you, Doctor, you're a rare find in Paris.

Came to Paris for a month before relocating from the US. We read in Dr. Pierre's reviews that he and his staff were some of the best at dealing with the particulars for pet passports. We were immediately struck by the care and attention to detail that this office gives to each client. They were beyond helpful with this process and we cannot give a higher recommendation. They were gentle and sweet with our pets too. To know that our cats were/are in good hands is such a comfort in a moment of madness (uprooting/moving abroad). Please look no further, this is your new Vet.

If you don’t have the EU pet passport avoid this practice for your UK paperwork!!! Shame to write this review but I used this practice in 2022 to get paperwork to renter the UK with my dog and it was a great experience. Easy to communicate with, nice people, and no issues with the paperwork. However this Saturday I visited again for the paperwork and was issued the wrong document. Because we don’t have a French address he wouldn’t issue a passport and instead gave us the wrong health certificate. We had to visit another vet in Calais for the right paperwork costing us 2 hours and €112. A huge mess that should have been avoided. I’ve contacted the practice regarding the mistake and they do not acknowledge they did not issue me the correct UK form. Thus high risk they will not issue correct paperwork in the future. Avoid!

We had our 8-month-old kitten neutered by Dr. Metivet. We received a very warm welcome and were notified at the end of the operation to let us know that everything had gone well!

Serious and professional, we highly recommend this clinic.
Very helpful and informative, and speaks English which we appreciate
Absolutely adorable
Excellent vet with reasonable prices, I highly recommend him

Fantastic vets. We visited having picked up our puppy from the airport and needed a health certificate to travel back to the uk. The vet spoke english perfectly so did the nurses and reception which was so helpful for us. They even made us a coffee while we waited and were so friendly and helpful couldn't be happier would give more that 5 stars.

Had an amazing vist with Dr Metivet to obtain health certificates for my cats to return from France to the US.
Pierre and the staff could not have been more helpful and gentle with my 2 12 year old cat and even did the amazing task of cutting their nails.
I cannot recommend their office enough.

Dr. Métivet is an exceptional veterinarian! Very professional, gentle, and attentive to our bulldog. He always takes the time to explain things clearly and answer all our questions. You can tell he truly loves animals and is passionate about his work. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Metivet is very competent, and in addition to being kind, he's passionate about animals. He takes wonderful care of our French bulldog, Poppy. He's truly excellent; I highly recommend him. You can go to him with complete confidence!
I've been going there for 6 years and the doctor and his team are always kind and ready to help with my sweet little chihuahua, El Chapo 💙🦊💙 …

Dr. Metivet is an excellent veterinarian. Very compassionate and will give you the best advice.

You can go to him with complete confidence! I highly recommend him.
Very pleasant and attentive, even on the phone they take the time to explain!

Dr Metivet is extremely knowledgeable, kind and his passion for animals is evident. He handles our boisterous Labrador so well (and our dog loves him too!). We also appreciate that Dr Metivet and his staff are always willing to assist us in English. Cannot recommend this vet enough!

I have been going to Dr Metivet since I moved to Paris. He and his staff have been wonderful with my senior cat. It seems like every month we had a health issue to work out. Dr Metivet showed exceptional concern over her health. He was spot on with his diagnosis and follow up. I could not have found a better vet. Dr Metivet and his staff speak excellent English and they always made sure I understood how and when to administer medication. Working with a vet that owns his own practice allows him to make the best decisions for my pet. My cat and I are very lucky to have found such a caring Dr and staff. Thank you for everything Dr Metivet.

Dr Peter and Maria are very friendly and helpful. My dog got his EU passport renewed fast and easy. Dr Peter is very chill and has a fun sense of humor, clinic was clean and organized. We got a very good toothbrush set and some delicious fish treats, they have good stuffs for purchase. They also saved some cute kittens on the day.

First visit and we discovered a veterinarian in Paris who feels just like a family doctor. Excellent communication, efficiency, and kindness—a real pleasure for owners and their pets. Thank you to him and his team. Scoty sends you all a kiss 🐶. …
It’s good service

For over forty years, my dogs and those of my aunts have been cared for by Doctors METIVET. First the father, then the son. Throughout all these years, both have supported us with professionalism and, above all, unwavering dedication.
Excellent veterinarian clinic. Easy to get an appointment. Staff was very kind and helpful. Vet was very caring and professional. English-speaking, too!
I'll be quick and efficient: the best vet in Paris

I brought my 8-year-old cat, who came from Quebec, to Dr. Métivet for surgery. I have honestly never met a veterinarian as compassionate, professional, and friendly as him and his team! A huge thank you to them.
Incredible vet and super nice staff
Excellent family-run veterinary clinic :)
Very welcoming and attentive. My little ones are in good hands with Salomé and Dr Metivet

I can't recommend Pierre and his team enough. They are amazing. We arrived with our dog Gilbert from Australia and made an appointment to have a health check and to issue a EU pet passport. They also helped me with other paperwork that is also required. They are meticulous and thorough and so helpful. They speak great English and were familiar with paperwork and regulations. Thank you so much to the team.
Doctor speaks English. Everyone was very kind, and my pup was able to get checked and get her EU passport.
Excellent!!!!!!!!!!! Best vet ever
Amazing vet. His entire staff speaks English and they are some of the nicest people too. Dr Metivet clearly loves animals.
the clinic is very professional and the people are very kind with the animals. thank you
Caring, knowledgeable and professional English-speaking vet in Paris. 100% recommend!
What a fantastic veterinarian. On our first visit with our dog, we were impressed with Dr Métivet’s kindness, sense of humor, enthusiasm, and professionalism.

Doctor Metivet is the absolute best. He is a jem who has been caring for our two dogs, Hermes and Winston for over 6 years. He is passionate about his work and genuinely loves animals and people too! He always finds solutions to treat the conditions of our dogs. We consider him as family.
The staff is great, Dr. Métivet is so kind to both animals and humans! 👍 …
The kindest Vet and staff; they were so welcoming, knowledgeable, and fast. So thankful to have found Dr. Métivet! Highly recommend.

Yuki, the long-haired Chihuahua's neutering, was a complete success. He ate immediately after the operation, relieved himself, and became much calmer.

Thank you so much to the doctor and the wonderful, smiling, and professional team!

Thank you also for reassuring me over the phone when Yuki was awake!
Excellent clinic, very sensitive and attentive doctor on weekdays.
The veterinary assistants are very kind, they have what they need in terms of renal products!

Attentive staff.
Top-notch vet.

Amazing clinic!! As a healthcare professional myself, I can easily say Dr Metivet is one of the most caring professionals I have ever met in the world. We are from New York and he is our go to Vet whenever we travel to Paris with our dog Munjee. Very kind, compassionate, and always has your best interest in mind. Thank you Dr Metivet and team!
Excellent veterinary clinic! I always receive a warm welcome and my cat is pampered! You feel completely at ease. A big thank you to the whole team!
